name: Duty or tax or fee type name code
description: Code specifying a type of duty, tax or fee.

values.name: Petroleum tax
values.description: Petroleum tax A tax levied on the volume of petroleum being transacted.

values.name: Provisional countervailing duty cash
values.description: Provisional countervailing duty cash Countervailing duty paid in cash prior to a formal finding of subsidization by Customs.

values.name: Provisional countervailing duty bond
values.description: Provisional countervailing duty bond Countervailing duty paid by posting a bond during an investigation period prior to a formal decision on subsidization by Customs.

values.name: Tobacco tax
values.description: Tobacco tax A tax levied on tobacco products.

values.name: Energy fee
values.description: Energy fee General fee or tax for the use of energy.

values.name: Coffee tax
values.description: Coffee tax A tax levied specifically on coffee products.

values.name: Harmonised sales tax, Canadian
values.description: Harmonised sales tax, Canadian A harmonized sales tax consisting of a goods and service tax, a Canadian provincial sales tax and, as applicable, a Quebec sales tax which is recoverable.

values.name: Quebec sales tax
values.description: Quebec sales tax A sales tax charged within the Canadian province of Quebec which is recoverable.

values.name: Canadian provincial sales tax
values.description: Canadian provincial sales tax A sales tax charged within Canadian provinces which is non-recoverable.

values.name: Tax on replacement part
values.description: Tax on replacement part A tax levied on a replacement part, where the original part is returned.

values.name: Mineral oil tax
values.description: Mineral oil tax Tax that is levied specifically on products containing mineral oil.

values.name: Special tax
values.description: Special tax To indicate a special type of tax.

values.name: Anti-dumping duty
values.description: Anti-dumping duty Duty applied to goods ruled to have been dumped in an import market at a price lower than that in the exporter's domestic market.

values.name: Stamp duty (Imposta di Bollo)
values.description: Stamp duty (Imposta di Bollo) Tax required in Italy, which may be fixed or graduated in various circumstances (e.g. VAT exempt documents or bank receipts).

values.name: Agricultural levy
values.description: Agricultural levy Levy imposed on agricultural products where there is a difference between the selling price between trading countries.

values.name: Car tax
values.description: Car tax A tax that is levied on the value of the automobile.

values.name: Paper consortium tax (Italy)
values.description: Paper consortium tax (Italy) Italian Paper consortium tax.

values.name: Commodity specific tax
values.description: Commodity specific tax Tax related to a specified commodity, e.g. illuminants, salts.

values.name: Customs duty
values.description: Customs duty Duties laid down in the Customs tariff, to which goods are liable on entering or leaving the Customs territory (CCC).

values.name: Countervailing duty
values.description: Countervailing duty A duty on imported goods applied for compensate for subsidies granted to those goods in the exporting country.

values.name: Environmental tax
values.description: Environmental tax Tax assessed for funding or assuring environmental protection or clean-up.

values.name: Excise duty
values.description: Excise duty Customs or fiscal authorities code to identify a specific or ad valorem levy on a specific commodity, applied either domestically or at time of importation.

values.name: Agricultural export rebate
values.description: Agricultural export rebate Monetary rebate given to the seller in certain circumstances when agricultural products are exported.

values.name: Federal excise tax
values.description: Federal excise tax Tax levied by the federal government on the manufacture of specific items.

values.name: Free
values.description: Free No tax levied.

values.name: General construction tax
values.description: General construction tax General tax for construction.

values.name: Goods and services tax
values.description: Goods and services tax Tax levied on the final consumption of goods and services throughout the production and distribution chain.

values.name: Illuminants tax
values.description: Illuminants tax Tax of illuminants.

values.name: Import tax
values.description: Import tax Tax assessed on imports.

values.name: Individual tax
values.description: Individual tax A tax levied based on an individual's ability to pay.

values.name: Business license fee
values.description: Business license fee Government assessed charge for permit to do business.

values.name: Local construction tax
values.description: Local construction tax Local tax for construction.

values.name: Light dues payable
values.description: Light dues payable Fee levied on a vessel to pay for port navigation lights.

values.name: Local sales tax
values.description: Local sales tax Assessment charges on sale of goods or services by city, borough country or other taxing authorities below state or provincial level.

values.name: Lust tax
values.description: Lust tax Tax imposed for clean-up of leaky underground storage tanks.

values.name: Monetary compensatory amount
values.description: Monetary compensatory amount Levy on Common Agricultural Policy (European Union) goods used to compensate for fluctuating currencies between member states.

values.name: Miscellaneous cash deposit
values.description: Miscellaneous cash deposit Duty paid and held on deposit, by Customs, during an investigation period prior to a final decision being made on any aspect related to imported goods (except valuation) by Customs.

values.name: Other taxes
values.description: Other taxes Unspecified, miscellaneous tax charges.

values.name: Provisional duty bond
values.description: Provisional duty bond Anti-dumping duty paid by posting a bond during an investigation period prior to a formal decision on dumping by Customs.

values.name: Provisional duty cash
values.description: Provisional duty cash Anti-dumping duty paid in cash prior to a formal finding of dumping by Customs.

values.name: Preference duty
values.description: Preference duty Duties laid down in the Customs tariff, to which goods are liable on entering or leaving the Customs territory falling under a preferential regime such as Generalised System of Preferences (GSP).

values.name: Special construction tax
values.description: Special construction tax Special tax for construction.

values.name: Shifted social securities
values.description: Shifted social securities Social securities share of the invoice amount to be paid directly to the social securities collector.

values.name: State/provincial sales tax
values.description: State/provincial sales tax All applicable sale taxes by authorities at the state or provincial level, below national level.

values.name: Suspended duty
values.description: Suspended duty Duty suspended or deferred from payment.

values.name: Surtax
values.description: Surtax A tax or duty applied on and in addition to existing duties and taxes.

values.name: Shifted wage tax
values.description: Shifted wage tax Wage tax share of the invoice amount to be paid directly to the tax collector(s office).

values.name: Alcohol mark tax
values.description: Alcohol mark tax A tax levied based on the type of alcohol being obtained.

values.name: Total
values.description: Total The summary amount of all taxes.

values.name: Turnover tax
values.description: Turnover tax Tax levied on the total sales/turnover of a corporation.

values.name: Tonnage taxes
values.description: Tonnage taxes Tax levied based on the vessel's net tonnage.

values.name: Valuation deposit
values.description: Valuation deposit Duty paid and held on deposit, by Customs, during an investigation period prior to a formal decision on valuation of the goods being made.

values.name: Value added tax
values.description: Value added tax A tax on domestic or imported goods applied to the value added at each stage in the production/distribution cycle.
